finding.name: iid_session_bootstrap_under_serial_dependence
finding.description: v7_graph_forward_guard.bootstrap_lower() resamples completed sessions independently. Adjacent sessions for the same structural signature can share the same event, queue regime, liquidity state and market-flow regime, so row-wise iid resampling is not a dependence-robust lower confidence bound.

deterministic_counterexample.interpretation: The same chronological PnL sequence passes a positive 10% lower bound under iid resampling and fails under a simple regime-preserving block bootstrap. This is a dependence counterexample, not an estimate of actual Polymarket serial correlation.

required_successor_contract: persist chronological session timestamps and do not reorder evidence
estimate dependence on a predeclared session/time scale and use moving/circular block bootstrap or another dependence-robust confidence procedure
do not count heavily overlapping windows as independent effective sessions
apply the same dependence-aware inference to 1x/1.5x/2x executable PnL after correcting full-completion and partial-state cashflows
condition or fail-closed transport evidence on the current execution state before using the lower bound for routing
